description: System invariants governing operational event telemetry and runtime observability streams.

invariants.name: Telemetry Uncommitted and Ephemeral
invariants.quoted_invariant: Never Commit Event Logs: Telemetry files (events/raw/, *.log) must remain untracked.
invariants.rule: Keep all telemetry streams, raw webhook deliveries, and event logs untracked and excluded from git commits.
invariants.drift_pattern: Staging and committing raw event payloads from events/ into git history.

invariants.name: Graceful Degradation Without Events
invariants.quoted_invariant: The control plane and operating loop must function even if events/ is empty or wiped.
invariants.rule: Ensure all core runtime logic, dispatching, and queue processing operate reliably even with empty or missing events storage.
invariants.drift_pattern: Coupling dispatch decisions or graph progress to historical event files.

invariants.name: Informational Telemetry Boundary
invariants.quoted_invariant: Event streams are informational; they do not dictate graph state or replace receipts.
invariants.rule: Rely on durable receipts and graph YAMLs as authorities of record, treating event logs purely as live observability.
invariants.drift_pattern: Deriving queue state or execution success directly from event logs rather than receipts.
